title: Skill Hub listing metadata (entries/skills/<id>/listing.json)
description: Optional. The icon and search tags shown for an entry. Kept out of entry.json (which clients parse strictly); build-index.py copies the resolved icon and tags into skills.json.

icon.description: An icon id from icons.json. Omit it to let scripts/listing.py pick one from the entry's categories, tags, name and summary.

tags.description: Search tags; the entry's categories are added automatically.
